data.name: Apollyon
data.description:
Apollyon was a girl born in a small village in the northern parts of the knights territory, North of them were vikings, who, after a MASSIVE earthquake that brought a long winter, were slaughtering everyone and looting towns for the simple purpose of getting enough food and water to survive.

With the knights under siege from the vikings, actively in a losing battle due to them being outnumbered they decided to retreat, during this retreat, Lawbringers were sent to evaluate towns and villages to decide if they were worth protecting.
Apollyons village was one of the ones that were deemed unworthy.

A few days after the retreat was set in motion the vikings reached her village, doing what they had to, looting and killing everyone they came across, Apollyon was one of the few survivors.

Seeing the horors of this attack, and how they were left to die simply because they weren't deemed strong enough to save she gets a wicked idea of the world, "realising" that it revolved around the strong ruling over, and overpowering the weak, the predators, and the pray as she called them. Humans she said were special because they could choose which they wanted to be.

Now an orphan she had to resort to stealing, mugging etc. to survive. 
At the age of 16, she managed to track down the lawbringer that doomed her village, she ambushed him, dragging him into a secluded spot before BRUTALLY slaughering him. She went on to keep his armor as a trophy hidden in her "home".

The murder was found out by the law, originally sentencing her to death. During her wait for the gallows a general decided to spare her, saying how he was impressed by her strength, recruiting her into the knight army.

In the army she did exceptionally well, quickly climbing the ranks and becoming a Warden, who were considered some of the most capable warriors of the Iron Legion, the strongest sub faction of the knights.

Speaking of the Iron legion, they were losing men to the vikings, being the first line of defence.  One of those men being their leader. With the leader gone, another took place, but he died shortly after, and than another, he suffered the same fate. There were 4 more of these so called "leaders" who all were assassinated or killed in battle, noticing what was going on Apollyon saw a chance, a chance to gain an army of her own.
She was sure she could hold the throne, and she DID.

Her first order was an insane one, she ordered her army to retreat, bringing the civilians along, and while doing so burn down every town and every piece of food they could find.
Still losing numbers and devoid of all hope from facing the vikings head on, the soldiers followed her order. After doing so, they were ordered to heavily reinforce the front, now with just 1 objective, hold your ground and kill any viking that approaches.

In doing this the vikings followed them into unfamiliar terrain, and because all shelter was destroyed, and food all burned they started starving, a few weeks later they retreated, now fighting each other for supplies. Realising they couldn’t attack the knights anymore they shifted their focus to the samurai, who have been preparing to storm the knights because of their weakened state. Which they did.

This plunged the world into all our war, everyone attacking everyone else, hunderds of thousands dying, yet Apollyon saw it as a victory, this is how the world is supposed to be. WAR

Part of the iron legion saw the chaos that has been created, and they despised it, while others, manipulated by Apollyon Swore this is how it's supposed to be. This created an internal conflict causing Apollyon to banish those who stood against her. 
She than renamed her faction to the Blackstone Legion.

The first thing she did as the ruler of the Blackstones was going back to her old hideout, where she had hidden that lawbringers armor all those years ago, and commisioned a blacksmith to reshape it to fit her, serving as a reminder of what happens when someone stands in her way, when someone stands in the way of WAR.

With the knights now devided, waging war amongst themselves too, the entire world was set aflame.

The last battle we see in the game, and the one where apollyon is defeated is one of MASSIVE proportions, The iron legion leading war with the blackstones launch the first of their attacks, they are met by Apollyons army, along with the vikings she offered food and shelter to. This word gets passed around, eventually reaching the samurai, who upon realising that apollyon is with the vikings decide to target the blackstones, instead of the iron legion, who were already only defending from them. With a part of every faction now raiding the blackstones territory, they reach her castle, after a long fight a "hero" finally reaches her, alone up top of a damaged tower looking over the battle happening below. She has a pridefull look on her face.
